content.short: Curve Finance is a DEX and AMM focused on efficient stablecoin trading with a range of stablecoins and DeFi features like liquidity mining and yield farming.
content.description: Curve Finance is an automated market maker and decentralized exchange focused on efficient stablecoin trading with low slippage. It supports a broad range of pegged assets, including USDT, USDC, TUSD, BUSD, and more, enabling users to swap between stablecoins with minimal price impact. Beyond swaps, Curve offers access to DeFi services such as liquidity mining and yield farming, allowing participants to earn rewards while aiming to reduce risk in stablecoin liquidity provision.
